CSES Problem Set

Two Sets

  • Task
  • Statistics
  • Time limit: 1.00 s
  • Memory limit: 512 MB

Divide the numbers 1,2,\ldots,n into two sets of equal sum.

Output

Print "YES", if the division is possible, and "NO" otherwise.

After this, if the division is possible, print an example of how to create the sets.

Example

Input:

6

Output:

NO
